verdict.rationale: Vanta publishes a per-endpoint API reference at developer.vanta.com/api-reference (list tests, upload contract, create custom control, list business units). The list-controls page tells users to pick a server from a dropdown to issue requests against the FedRAMP host, which points to an interactive request console built into the reference. missing for 10: explicit documentation of runnable copy-paste code samples or a 'try it' playground beyond the server-dropdown mention, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
